sources.title: Airalo homepage
sources.span: Site presents Local eSIMs, Regional eSIMs, Global eSIMs and unlimited data options for iPhone, iPad and Android; headline 'A better way to stay connected'; sub-headline 'Buy eSIMs for affordable, flexible coverage around the world'; '200+ locations'; most locations start at $6.00 CAD and Canada at $10.00 CAD at access time; named programme items include 'Football 2026 eSIMs', Airalo Partners, refer and earn, loyalty programme; states devices must be eSIM-compatible and network unlocked and that installation needs a WiFi/network connection.
sources.span_locator: homepage hero, package navigation and device-compatibility block

sources.span: Popular help questions listed as 'How do I check if my iOS device supports eSIM?', 'How do I install and set up an eSIM on my iOS device?', 'When does my eSIM data package expire?', 'How do I install and set up an eSIM on my Android device?', 'How can I get an eSIM?', 'Why is my eSIM not working?'. sources.title: Airalo Japan eSIM packages
sources.span: Japan local packages listed as unlimited-data durations of 3, 5, 7, 10, 15 and 30 days priced $16.50 to $98.00 CAD at access time; network shown as Softbank plus one other network; page states you can 'top up your eSIM - you don't need to buy a new eSIM to stay connected' where available and 'Install as soon as you'd like - just make sure you have stable internet connection.'
sources.span_locator: destination package table and FAQ block

sources.title: Airalo eSIM Review: Is It Safe, Legit & Worth It?
sources.span: Page states 'Last updated July 2, 2026'. Reports that on unlimited regional plans 'Speed is capped at approximately 1 Mbps once you exceed the daily fair-use threshold' of 3 GB/day, making heavy tethering impractical; lists 'Local phone number not always included' as a con with only the premium Discover+ tier providing a digital international phone number; states 'Carrier-locked phones will fail' and calls carrier lock 'the most common complaint from new users'; notes an eSIM cannot be moved to a friend's handset if a phone breaks; names Holafly, Yesim, Saily, Ubigi and Nomad as alternatives.
sources.span_locator: pros/cons section, unlimited-plan section and alternatives section

sources.title: Nomad vs Airalo eSIM Comparison: Features, Pricing & Coverage
sources.span: Dated 12.09.25. States Airalo 'global plans cover 137 countries' alongside regional and country-specific options; describes 5-10% cashback via 'Airmoney'; top-up available in app or by buying a new eSIM; notes 'Some packages, like Discover+ global plans, include calls and texts'; lists limitations of single-device use and that devices from China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan may lack compatibility.
sources.span_locator: feature comparison table and limitations list

sources.title: Best eSIM for Japan Reddit 2026
sources.span: Page states April 2026 and characterises r/JapanTravel, r/eSIM and r/travel discussion. Reports traveller phrasings 'which eSIM should I get for Japan?', 'Is Airalo reliable in Japan?', 'Is Holafly really unlimited?', 'What's the cheapest Japan eSIM?' and 'Does eSIM work in rural Japan?'. Recurring complaints reported: data-only with no voice calls and no local number, throttling after heavy use, slow support response, rural coverage in mountainous areas.

sources.title: SIM Card Verification Rules 2026: Traveler Guide
sources.span: Undated page. States 'Do not assume that eSIM automatically means no verification. An eSIM is digital, but the mobile line behind it can still be subject to local SIM registration laws.' Lists common requirements as passport or national ID check, face or selfie verification, proof of local address or stay, and payment verification, and notes there is still no single EU-wide anonymous SIM ban applied uniformly. Names no specific countries.

sources.title: Stay connected for the FIFA World Cup 2026 with Visible's new eSIM Travel Pass
sources.span: Vendor-published announcement dated Mar 25, 2026, independent of the target but promotional. Frames the offer as giving 'international travelers the simplest way to access premium U.S. data the second they land' and references 'the FIFA World Cup 2026 Final in New York City on July 19'. Pre-orders ran until June 10, 2026; passes ranged from 7 to 45 days.

sources.title: The State of Consumer eSIM in 2026
sources.span: Operator-vendor analysis dated February 10, 2026 citing named third-party research. Cites Juniper Research that eSIM connections will 'shortly surpass 1.5 billion connections as part of a 250% increase over the next four years', and Kaleido Intelligence that 'travel eSIM adoption is now a primary driver of retail roaming spend', with consumers preferring third-party providers over home-operator packages when pricing is more competitive; describes connectivity as 'a standard travel necessity'.
